title: Classification Of Robots
definition: Classification of robots involves categorizing mechanical agents based on their kinematics, application domain, control architecture, and level of autonomy, serving as the foundational taxonomy for industrial automation, service sectors, and advanced AI deployment.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC Civil Services Prelims (Science & Technology - emerging technologies, AI, robotics) and Mains GS Paper III (Indigenization of technology, manufacturing competitiveness, automation impact on employment).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Classification Of Robots.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of Artificial Intelligence, Actuators, Sensors, and Cyber-Physical Systems.
